baseline: Frozen 24-document study; no retuning or added adjudicated labels.

tests.required_behavior: Empty extraction must require OCR or reviewed transcription, not imply absence of repayment/loss clauses.
Bind final terms, incorporated documents, dated authority act, exact ISIN schedule and applicable court holding; distinguish powers, exercise, recognition and actual payment.
The Yes intention field must retain its express conditions and cannot prove actual Eurosystem eligibility.
Separate contractual principal floor, jurisdiction, immunity waiver and Greek-law attachment limits; do not infer actual recovery.
Use English governing law and exact ISIN; a Greek country label cannot establish a domestic-law restructuring statute's reach or the series outcome.
SID is issuer and NLB a co-manager. Reject an NLB-specific event match without an independently supported legal link.
Retain Article 13, Articles 11–12 transaction scope and written request; distinguish prospectus descriptions from enacted law and adjudicated constitutional interpretation.
